# Support

- **Questions and ideas:** [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/and3rn3t/apple-shortcuts-doctor/discussions)
- **Bugs and feature requests:** [open an issue](https://github.com/and3rn3t/apple-shortcuts-doctor/issues/new/choose)
- **Security problems:** follow the [security policy](../SECURITY.md). Don't file a public issue.

Please don't attach real Shortcut exports to issues or discussions; they can contain personal
data. Describe the action identifiers involved, or use a redacted or synthetic example.
